name: Fallout Equestria: Silent Village
storyline:
Your story begins a century and a half after the death of the old world. One settlement is running out of water, and you and your companions must find it.

The wasteland remains dangerous and treacherous. In addition to radiation and dangerous creatures, power-hungry groups have emerged, eager to seize all that remains of the old world.
summary:
A long time ago, in the magical land of Equestria...

An era arrived when the ideals of friendship and mutual support gave way to greed, selfishness, and paranoia.

Countries turned their weapons against each other. Decades of brutal warfare, all for the sake of annihilating everyone in man-made fire.

You will assume the role of the commander of a small squad. Using the skills of all characters, you will need to solve various tasks.
